groups.label: Blue tones
groups.blurb: The cool blue masses and lines that give the arch its airy spring feel.

items.role: Large blue flower balls dotted through the greenery.
Tall blue-violet spikes reaching above the arch line.
Misty-blue small roses tucked low, adding a vintage blue note.

groups.label: Purple accents
groups.blurb: Purple clusters and fillers balancing the blue masses.

items.role: High purple line flowers at the top of the arch.
Purple hydrangea clusters along the top edge.
Fine purple filler scattered between the main blooms.

groups.label: Yellow pops
groups.blurb: Warm yellow accents waking up the blue-purple-green base.

items.role: Bright yellow round mum clusters on the left side.
Orange-yellow rose heads near the top left.
Fine line flowers scattered sparsely through the arch.

groups.label: Pink & white
groups.blurb: Lilies as the visual anchors, with soft pink and white fillers.

items.role: Large pink lilies at the lower right — the focal point of this arch.
White lilies anchored at the bottom.
A cluster of soft pink ranunculus on the left.
Tiny white daisies floating through the air of the arch.

groups.label: Greens & grasses
groups.blurb: The large fluffy green base carrying the whole arch — pine needle greenery is the backbone here.

items.role: Large fluffy needle greenery — the main base layer of this arch.
Light airy grass strands softening the mass.
Grey-green round leaves dotted through the greens.
Fine berry-bearing branches threading through the greenery.
